description: Adds a contact as the Add contact form does: a name, a phone (with area code) or an email is enough. contact_type picks client (default), lead, applicant, staff or other. A phone or email that already belongs to a contact is refused with that contact (duplicate_contact, its id in the message); use it, or pass createAnyway: true only for a different person who shares it (a shared phone then stays with its owner). Look a person up first with findClientByIdentifier or read. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the contact the first call made. platform_customer links the contact to its booking platform customer id (platform defaults to the company's one booking platform); an id another contact holds is refused with that contact. address {line, apt, zip} saves the client's service address with the contact (its default), through the same address book as add_client_address; a line without a 5-digit ZIP refuses the whole call (zip_required) and creates nothing. A booking for this client then books at that address.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
